reading: Matthew Rhys, a Welsh performer, recently made Emmy history by winning two lead acting awards in one night.
He received one award for a psychological thriller and another for a comedy series.
Earlier in his career, Rhys was so desperate for employment that he thought about joining the British Army.
However, an army officer was suspicious of him because he was a performer, and Rhys was later rejected.
Years later, Rhys moved to Hollywood and lived with other Welsh performers, including Michael Sheen and Ioan Gruffudd.
They would speak Welsh to each other and watch rugby games together in a British pub.
Rhys is married to actress Keri Russell, and they have a son named Sam, whom Rhys hopes will understand the Welsh language.
He also owns a 1939 wooden boat named Rarebit, which is also a traditional Welsh dish.
Rhys's first language is Welsh, and he regularly uses it at home in New York.
The passionate Welshman dedicated his second Emmy award to the great and good people of Wales.
He said, "We are a small but mighty nation," expressing pride in his heritage.
Rhys has also been revealed as the voice of Han Solo in a new Welsh language adaptation of Star Wars.
This project, which required translating well-known phrases, brought up some unexpected feelings for Rhys.

vocabulary.definition: Someone who entertains an audience, for example, by acting, singing, or dancing.
Feeling or showing that you have little hope and are ready to do anything to change a difficult situation.
The state of having a job or working for an employer.
Feeling or thinking that someone is probably guilty of something bad.
To refuse to accept, use, or believe something or someone.
Showing or involving strong feelings or a strong belief.
To give all of your energy, time, etc. to something.
A film, book, play, etc., that has been made from another film, book, or play.
A small group of words that stands together as a conceptual unit, but is not necessarily a complete sentence.

entries.ja: 観客を楽しませる人、例えば、演技したり、歌ったり、踊ったりする人。
entries.ko: 연기, 노래 또는 춤 등으로 관객을 즐겁게 하는 사람.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过表演、唱歌或跳舞等方式娱乐观众的人。
entries.es: Alguien que entretiene a una audiencia, por ejemplo, actuando, cantando o bailando.
entries.pt-BR: Alguém que diverte uma plateia, por exemplo, atuando, cantando ou dançando.

entries.ja: ほとんど希望がなく、困難な状況を変えるためには何でもする用意があると感じたり示したりしていること。
entries.ko: 희망이 거의 없음을 느끼거나 보여주며, 어려운 상황을 바꾸기 위해 무엇이든 할 준비가 되어 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 感到或表现出希望渺茫，并准备好做任何事来改变困难局面的。
entries.es: Sentir o mostrar que se tiene poca esperanza y que se está dispuesto a hacer cualquier cosa para cambiar una situación difícil.
entries.pt-BR: Sentir ou mostrar que se tem pouca esperança e que se está pronto para fazer qualquer coisa para mudar uma situação difícil.

entries.ja: 仕事を持っている状態、または雇用主のために働いている状態。
entries.ko: 직업을 가지고 있거나 고용주를 위해 일하는 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 有工作或为雇主工作的情况。
entries.es: El estado de tener un trabajo o de trabajar para un empleador.
entries.pt-BR: O estado de ter um emprego ou de trabalhar para um empregador.

entries.ja: 誰かが悪いことに関わっている可能性が高いと感じたり考えたりしていること。
entries.ko: 누군가가 나쁜 짓을 저질렀을 것이라고 느끼거나 생각하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 感觉或认为某人可能犯了坏事。
entries.es: Sentir o pensar que alguien es probablemente culpable de algo malo.
entries.pt-BR: Sentir ou pensar que alguém é provavelmente culpado de algo ruim.

entries.ja: 何かや誰かを受け入れたり、使ったり、信じたりすることを拒否すること。
entries.ko: 무언가나 누군가를 받아들이거나, 사용하거나, 믿는 것을 거부하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 拒绝接受、使用或相信某事物或某人。
entries.es: Rechazar aceptar, usar o creer algo o a alguien.
entries.pt-BR: Recusar-se a aceitar, usar ou acreditar em algo ou alguém.

entries.ja: 強い感情や強い信念を示している、またはそれらを含んでいること。
entries.ko: 강한 감정이나 강한 믿음을 보이거나 포함하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 表现出或涉及强烈感情或坚定信念的。
entries.es: Que muestra o implica sentimientos fuertes o una creencia fuerte.
entries.pt-BR: Que demonstra ou envolve sentimentos fortes ou uma crença forte.

entries.ja: 自分のエネルギー、時間などを全て何かに捧げること。
entries.ko: 자신의 모든 에너지와 시간 등을 어떤 일에 바치다.
entries.zh-Hans: 将自己所有的精力、时间等投入到某事物中。
entries.es: Dar toda tu energía, tiempo, etc. a algo.
entries.pt-BR: Dedicar toda a sua energia, tempo, etc. a algo.

entries.ja: 非常に強くて力強いこと。
別の映画、本、劇などから作られた映画、本、劇などのこと。
entries.ko: 다른 영화, 책, 연극 등으로부터 만들어진 영화, 책, 연극 등을 말한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 根据另一部电影、书籍或戏剧改编而成的电影、书籍、戏剧等。
entries.es: Una película, libro, obra de teatro, etc., que ha sido hecha a partir de otra película, libro u obra de teatro.
entries.pt-BR: Um filme, livro, peça de teatro, etc., que foi feito a partir de outro filme, livro ou peça de teatro.

entries.ja: 概念的な単位としてまとまっている小さな単語のグループで、必ずしも完全な文ではないもの。
entries.ko: 개념적인 단위로 함께 사용되지만 반드시 완전한 문장은 아닌 작은 단어들의 그룹.
entries.zh-Hans: 作为概念单元组合在一起的一小群词语，但不一定是完整的句子。
entries.es: Un pequeño grupo de palabras que se mantiene unido como una unidad conceptual, pero que no es necesariamente una oración completa.
entries.pt-BR: Um pequeno grupo de palavras que se mantém junto como uma unidade conceitual, mas que não é necessariamente uma frase completa.
